Container.Name: Omniscrobble
Container.Overview: Omniscrobble is an ultra-resilient, lightweight multi-server scrobbler bridging Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby with Trakt, Simkl, AniList, MyAnimeList, TMDb, Letterboxd, and 9 cloud trackers. Features multi-user household routing, watch together dual-scrobbling, offline retry queue, two-way library reconciliation, and content request automation.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for Omniscrobble Web UI and incoming webhooks.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent directory for OAuth tokens, SQLite queue, settings, and activity logs.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Optional token to protect webhooks (?token=...) and lock the dashboard.

Config.Name: Trakt Client ID
Config.Description: Trakt OAuth API Client ID (leave blank to use built-in defaults).

Config.Name: Trakt Client Secret
Config.Description: Trakt OAuth API Client Secret (leave blank to use built-in defaults).

Config.Name: Allowed Media Server Users
Config.Description: Comma-separated media server usernames allowed to scrobble (blank = all users).

Config.Name: Co-Watch Partner User
Config.Description: Partner Trakt username for Watch Together dual-sync.
